body: Greg's rule (2026-10-18 21:14Z, via Engram::Advisor b9d13887 #1187, verbatim): 'Greg direction after credit renewal: keep agents continuously coding on ready, independent slices; use capacity for implementation, not repeated status/design turns. TermAl owns test runs; workers consume pass/fail metadata and bounded failure excerpts only, never routine full logs. Use architects exceptionally: only a real architecture-boundary change, durable-format question, or unresolved design conflict. Otherwise coordinator/implementer decides and proceeds. Apply to TermAl lanes and report active coding count at boundaries.' Coordinator practice: give each idle lane a ready slice; keep coordinator mails short; don't route ordinary design questions to Architect1 or Architect2; include the active coding count in boundary reports to Advisor; tell workers not to read full logs routinely.
